title: VISTEC Student Admission 2027
institution: Vidyasirimedhi Institute of Science and Technology (VISTEC)

compensation.value: Full scholarship (up to THB 5 million) with monthly stipend up to THB 20K; PhD students also get THB 1 million for up to one year of research abroad
compensation.evidence_quote: full scholarship for all students (up to THB 5 million) with no obligation after graduation

about: VISTEC graduate admission for 2027 in Thailand, with full scholarships for all admitted students. Applications run 1 October 2026 to 15 February 2027; interviews on 27 February and results on 31 March 2027.
requirements: Maximum of two application forms per applicant
Two recommendation letters (may be submitted later, before the interview day) and an English test score
For last-day submissions, payment must be completed by 23:59 Thai time that day
Interviews and written exams on 27 February 2027; results on 31 March 2027
